Name: Grassy Tiled Soil
Author: xyariaa
Description:
There are many modded farm giving you beautiful all-grass land to cultivate.
And really, it looks awesome.
But the vanilla tiled soil texture was really only meant to be placed onto dirt. Some don't care, other find the contrast not very aesthetic.

This little mods tries to remedy this contrast by adding a few options to chose from.
[left][/left]
[center][size=5]Features[/size][/center]
[left][/left]
[left][list]
[*]Retextured Tiled Soil to fit onto grass[/*]
[*]Several options to chose from: grass border, flowery grass border,, no border, dirt background[/*]
[*]Recolor Support! Currently supports Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn, DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolor, Xiddav's Dirt Recolor[/*]
[*]You can use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] for easier configuration of your soil appearance[/*]
[*]/!\ You need to select the soil appearance from the main menu! It won't change if you're already loaded into the game[/*]
[/list]I also made a companion mod called [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/51719]Dirt Path[/url], adding a cute little dirt path, which has an additional "flat-edged" path: it was made to fit around this mod's "dirt background" soil retexture.[/left]
[left][/left]
[left][center][size=5]Installation[/size][/center]
[list]
[*]Download the mod[/*]
[*]Extract the mod[/*]
[*]Place the mod in your Mods folder[/*]
[*]Don't forget requirements![/*]
[/list][/left]
